definitions.short: Nearjah , the name of two Israelites
definitions.full: H5294. Nearyah נְעַרְיָה proper name, masculine 1. a descendant of David 1Chr 3:22-23 , ᵐ5 Νωαδεια , ᵐ5 L Νεαριου . 2 a Simeonite 1Chr 4:42 ; ᵐ5 id. , ᵐ5 L Νααριας (compare Sinaitic proper name נערת Cook 82 ).

occurrences.englishText: The son of Shecaniah: Shemaiah. The sons of Shemaiah: Hattush, Igal, Bariah, Neariah, and Shaphat, six.
The sons of Neariah: Elioenai, Hizkiah, and Azrikam, three.
Some of them, even of the sons of Simeon, five hundred men, went to Mount Seir, having for their captains Pelatiah, Neariah, Rephaiah, and Uzziel, the sons of Ishi.
